title: Taiyo Holdings and imec Announce 700nm Three-Layer RDL Formation: Progress and Challenges in Advanced Packaging Materials
excerpt: On September 10, 2026, Taiyo Holdings announced three-layer RDL formation with 700nm wiring and vias in joint research with imec. This beginner-friendly article explains the role of FPIM material, progress since earlier evaluations, and the issues to confirm before mass production.
